eyebrow: The screen your staff actually use
header: Eleven buttons, and nine of them are your own articles
lead: A till that has to be learned is a till that gets worked around on a Saturday morning.
bodytext:
The counter view is built from your article list, not from a menu tree. Semmel, Kaffee, Vollkornbrot sit where you put them and stay there, and the four buttons that are not yours are the ones the law requires: cash, card, cancel, receipt.

New staff are usually serving on their own after one shift. That is the only training figure we have, and it comes from watching, not from a survey.
caption: The counter view on the tablet at Café Hollergrund in Linz.
note: A demo is a live session with somebody who has installed tills in bakeries, not a recording.
